RESULT (#268 — REQ-7 anchor class, FIXED, single file forge/src/engine.rs):

Two-commit ceremony complete:
  (1) cf4c5b94 — forge: #268 fix — interactive replay theorem-needle is an exact-name match, never a prefix
  (2) <pin> — design: bump proof-backends.md audited-sha to cf4c5b94

ROOT CAUSE: canonical_theorem_statement (~1650) and reconstruct_replay (~1112) anchored on a raw prefix find of `theorem thermite_obligation_<item>`. On a while-shaped multi-theorem file (_entry first, bare contract theorem lower, _converges after) the FIRST match latched _entry, binding the WRONG theorem and dropping the 5+2 conjunction. Latent today (while items auto-tier; replay_interactive unreachable per #264) — a soundness seam the moment a multi-theorem file routes interactive. Same class as the #249/#250 axiom anchor.

FIX (root cause): new helper theorem_anchor_pos(source, thm_name) requires the char after <thm_name> to be a non-identifier (not alphanumeric/_/.) + the theorem keyword to start a token (mirrors declaration_sites). BOTH sites now call it. SWEEP: these were the ONLY two prefix-find theorem-header anchors (nonstandard_axiom builds an anchored #print-axioms parse; declaration_sites already exact-token). Whole class covered.

  before: let needle = format!("theorem {thm_name}"); source.find(&needle)?
  after:  theorem_anchor_pos(source, &thm_name)?

PIN (in-module, crate-private): interactive_needle_is_exact_name_never_prefix_on_while_shaped_file — while-shaped multi-theorem source, asserts the BARE theorem's statement binds (not _entry's), plus the low-level anchor offset lands past _entry. VERIFIED FAILS pre-fix via temporary revert (it latched _entry's `Exists.intro st (And.intro hb hi)`), PASSES post-fix.

No new pub API (theorem_anchor_pos is crate-private; R-DEFER-1 n/a).

GAUNTLET (all green):
  cargo build -p forge: PASS
  cargo clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings: PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check: PASS (exit 0)
  cargo test -p forge --bins: 285 passed, 0 failed (incl. the #248-#252 bypass regression suite + the live interactive tests)
  cargo test -p forge --test lean_engine --test lean_while: 2 + 5 passed (lake live)
  python3 tooling/doc-drift.py: exit 0 (proof-backends.md CURRENT at cf4c5b94)

Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
